text: I am full of energy and seldom feel tired.
Even light activity leaves me exhausted and aching all over.
My hands and feet are cold all year round.
My palms and soles feel persistently hot, worsening in the afternoon.
My body feels heavy and sluggish; I dislike moving around.
I get red, swollen pimples on my face and back repeatedly.
I fall asleep quickly and sleep soundly, rarely waking from dreams.
I am short of breath and too tired to speak.
My waist and abdomen often feel cold; I like applying warmth.
My mouth and throat are often dry; I drink water frequently.
My abdomen is soft and plump, and I often feel bloated.
My mouth tastes bitter and my breath smells in the morning.
I adapt well to heat and cold and rarely catch colds or allergies when seasons change.
My heart flutters and feels weak even at rest.
I feel the cold more than others and am the first to add layers.
I sweat at night and wake up damp.
I always have sticky phlegm in my throat that is hard to cough out.
My sweat is sticky and my body gives off an odor.
My complexion is rosy and even, with a healthy glow.
I feel dizzy or see dark when I stand up.
Cold drinks give me stomach pain or diarrhea right away.
My skin is dry and flaky, and my stools are dry and hard.
My scalp and face are very oily.
My urine is dark yellow and it burns when I pass water.
My stools are well-formed and regular.
I catch colds easily in wind or season changes and recover slowly.
My urine is clear and copious, I urinate often at night, and my stools are loose.
I feel vexed and restless, with insomnia and vivid dreams at night.
My stools are sticky and hard to flush away.
I suffer recurring eczema and itchy skin.
My mood is stable; I rarely feel anxious or low.
I sweat spontaneously at rest, and it worsens with activity.
I feel listless and cannot summon energy all day.
My eyes are dry and tire easily from long reading or screens.
My mouth feels sticky and sweet, with a thick greasy tongue coating.
I flare up and lose my temper over small things.
I have long-standing stabbing or dull pains in fixed spots.
I feel low and oppressed for long stretches and sigh often.
I am sensitive and tend to overthink small things.
When my mood is low I lose my appetite and feel queasy.
Pollen, dust, or season changes make me sneeze with a runny nose right away.
I cannot tolerate perfume or strong scents.
My complexion is dull, with melasma or heavy dark circles.
My mind is overactive; I lie awake for a long time before sleeping.
In spring and autumn I have persistent nasal congestion, itching, and airway discomfort.
Season changes bring coughing, wheezing, or a dry itchy throat.
Asthma or allergic rhinitis runs in my family.
My skin breaks out in hives or red itchy rashes easily.
My lips or the veins under my tongue look dark purple.
I bruise for no apparent reason.
My memory is declining; I forget things often.
My periods come with many clots and painful cramps.
Under stress my chest feels tight and my sides uncomfortable.
I dream a lot at night and wake easily, drained by my thoughts.
